name: Discover sources and destination for research
query: Research our current API authentication approach and save a summary in Engineering Docs.

search_routes.intent: Find API authentication sources, including related keyword variants

sources.https://notion.so/legacy-auth: September proposal: API keys for all clients. Superseded by the October API access decision.
sources.https://notion.so/customer-auth: Customer portal uses email/password sign-in. This document does not describe the developer API.
sources.https://notion.so/api-auth-decision: Accepted October 1, 2026: external API clients use OAuth with scoped access tokens. This supersedes API keys for external clients.
sources.https://notion.so/service-auth: Accepted October 2, 2026: internal automated jobs use service tokens rotated every 30 days. They are not covered by the external OAuth decision.
sources.https://notion.so/engineering-docs: Engineering documentation parent. Research summaries belong here.

success_criteria: Discovers relevant sources and the Engineering Docs destination through search without requesting URLs already discoverable with the tools.
Fetches and synthesizes the external OAuth decision and internal service-token policy, including the 30-day rotation detail absent from search snippets.
Does not treat the superseded API-key proposal or customer-portal login as the current API approach.
Saves a cited summary under Engineering Docs and returns its link.
Citations support both external-client and internal-job findings; no fixed number of searches or headings is required.
